text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Split up... Split up... Please, I'm beggin'
ya...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
This track is the widest one of them all.
Which
means... I should be safe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby—one of the biggest
events
in racing. Yet we're taking it on
at arguably the
worst time possible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Assuming there are no last-minute
cancellations,
the Japanese Derby is
guaranteed to have a full
gate. And
Tamamo Cross is still in no condition to

fight a full pack.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm real sorry 'bout actin' up like
this...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But I'm still in it to win it, don't you
worry! I'll just
run alongside the rest of
'em...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no telling how she'll fare. But for
now, the
most important thing to say is...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Congrats? Can you really say that when
my
runnin's a mess?
choice_data_list: 出られるだけでも立派だ
出られるだけでも立派だよ

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The top eighteen... Yeah, when ya put it
like
that...
choice_data_list: ああ、世代最強の18人に入ったんだ
うん、世代最強の18人に入ったんだから

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I started at rock bottom, but today I'm
runnin' in
the Derby... Even that's worth
somethin'...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I bet they've got their eyes
glued to the
screen right about now.
choice_data_list: 家族にいいところを見せよう

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even if I lose, there's no way I'm lettin'
'em see me
wimp out on my big break.
I... I...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I got this! For real! I'm gonna run the
best I can!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We manage to boost our morale
somehow. For
the time being, that's the
best I can ask of her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now all that's left is to bet on her
appetite for
victory. Holding out hope, I
send her off towards
Fuchu's giant
zelkova trees.
